trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west. It was failing health checks with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, is also marked unhealthy.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release marked healthy. After switching to it, all three regions report healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%. Because v2.3.0 has been healthy in production before, this didn't need change-manager approval.
- **Incident:** INC-0002 describes the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback and the recovery. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 problem needs to be found before it's deployed again. My first attempt to create it timed out. The incident list was empty when I checked, so I tried again, and that worked. There should be only one incident, but the ID is INC-0002 even though the list was empty, so it's worth confirming there isn't a stray duplicate.
